description: This file declares the Timer class and TimerFactory class within the firebolt::rialto::common namespace. It defines interfaces and classes for creating and managing timers, including methods for starting, canceling, and checking the activity status of timers. The file also includes licensing information and include guards.

classes.name: TimerFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating Timer instances, implementing the ITimerFactory interface.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class representing a timer that can be started, canceled, and queried for activity status, implementing the ITimer interface.

methods.name: TimerFactory::createTimer
methods.description: Creates a new Timer object with specified timeout, callback, and timer type.

methods.name: Timer::cancel
methods.description: Cancels the timer if it is active.

methods.name: Timer::isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the timer is currently active.
